critical_only.interpretation: Before the protocol fix, historical screenshots were not supplied to the VLM.

history_visual_rerun.interpretation: Supplying visual history restores critical decisions, but one-epoch projector training saturates both CE and TANGO and causes large non-critical score shifts; this is a protocol/mechanism diagnostic, not an online win.

causal_visual_history_ablation.interpretation: Removing the earliest cue screenshot destroys the delayed decision. In this v1 dataset, history index 1 was absent at the critical prefix, so that condition was an empty-operation control and is superseded by tango_memory_credit_v2_pilot20.json.
